info.name: AppDynamics Alert and Respond Actions Queries API

params.name: start
params.description: The start time for the query in ISO 8601 format or relative time notation.

params.name: end
params.description: The end time for the query in ISO 8601 format or relative time notation.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics Query Language (ADQL) query against stored events and returns the results. Supports both simple text-formatted queries and JSON-formatted queries that accommodate multiple queries per call. Rate limited to 450 requests per minute per account and 145 requests per minute per API key.
